tools.name: report_agent_bug
tools.description: Record a minimal technical PodPitch failure without an account. Report concrete tool failures once. Exclude credentials, personal data, pitches and conversations. Respect client approval. Returns a persisted report ID.

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Find active podcasts by topic or name. No account needed. Returns public show information and listening links, never contact addresses.

tools.name: get_podcast_details
tools.description: Read public details for a podcast from search. No account or contact addresses.

tools.name: get_connected_account
tools.description: Return the account represented by this connection, with a stable opaque profile ID and display email.

tools.name: create_podcast_campaign
tools.description: Create a podcast campaign in Off mode using a team profile and connected senders. Existing plan and first-campaign setup checks apply.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Read your team's campaign and its settings.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Update campaign name, writing, follow-up, and tracking settings. Scheduling uses schedule_campaign.

tools.name: edit_pitch_draft
tools.description: Edit a saved, unscheduled pitch at its expected stage. Refresh before editing; scheduled messages use edit_upcoming_send.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List up to 50 campaign summaries, newest first. Use next_before_id as before_id for the next page. Read complete settings with get_campaign.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List your team's profiles.

tools.name: create_profile
tools.description: Create a profile for your team.

tools.name: archive_profile
tools.description: Archive a profile belonging to your team.

tools.name: unarchive_profile
tools.description: Restore an archived profile.

tools.name: search_account_podcasts
tools.description: Search podcasts with your account's filters and search allowance.

tools.name: get_account_podcast
tools.description: Read a podcast's full account-accessible record.

tools.name: get_campaign_drafts
tools.description: Read saved drafts for any campaign type, including podcast campaigns. Returns all six email stages, generation/error and pause/send state. tools.name: get_campaign_draft_previews

tools.name: get_campaign_audit
tools.description: Read the change history of your campaign.

tools.name: get_profile_audit
tools.description: Read the change history of your profile.

tools.name: get_subject_results
tools.description: Read subject line performance for your campaign.

tools.name: add_contacts_to_campaign
tools.description: Add selected contacts to your campaign through the existing duplicate checks.

tools.name: send_pitch
tools.description: Send a pitch through PodPitch's existing authorization, plan, campaign-mode, and daily pitch limits. Sends an email.

tools.name: schedule_campaign
tools.description: Schedule campaign pitches through the existing campaign and pitch-limit checks.

tools.name: get_campaign_schedule
tools.description: Read scheduled campaign sends.

tools.name: pause_campaign_schedule
tools.description: Pause pending sends for your campaign.

tools.name: disable_campaign_schedule
tools.description: Disable pending sends for your campaign.

tools.name: set_campaign_mode
tools.description: Set a campaign Off or Manual through the existing mode checks. MagicPitch does not allow Manual.

tools.name: list_inbox_threads
tools.description: Search or list your team's inbox threads with pagination.

tools.name: read_inbox_thread
tools.description: Read a thread in a mailbox belonging to your team.

tools.name: reply_to_inbox_thread
tools.description: Send a reply in a thread belonging to your team. Sends an email.

tools.name: mark_inbox_thread
tools.description: Mark a thread read, unread, starred, or archived.

tools.name: get_inbox_counts
tools.description: Read inbox status counts.

tools.name: list_inbox_labels
tools.description: List your team's inbox labels.

tools.name: create_inbox_label
tools.description: Create an inbox label.

tools.name: get_upcoming_sends
tools.description: Read upcoming sends for your team.

tools.name: cancel_upcoming_send
tools.description: Cancel an upcoming send belonging to your team.

tools.name: edit_upcoming_send
tools.description: Edit an upcoming unsent message through existing validation.

tools.name: reschedule_upcoming_send
tools.description: Reschedule an upcoming send through existing scheduling validation.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Read your team's writing templates.

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a writing template.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update a writing template belonging to your team.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a writing template belonging to your team.

tools.name: list_media_lists
tools.description: List your team's saved media lists.

tools.name: read_podcast_media_list
tools.description: Read a podcast media list belonging to your team.

tools.name: list_excluded_contacts
tools.description: Read your team's excluded contacts.

tools.name: exclude_contacts
tools.description: Add or update your team's contact exclusions.

tools.name: list_connected_senders
tools.description: List connected sender accounts, connection status, and daily capacity. Never returns credentials.

tools.name: get_pitch_activity
tools.description: Read your team's recent pitch, reply, booking, and open counts.

tools.name: get_campaign_build_progress
tools.description: Read draft generation progress for your team's campaign.

tools.name: rewrite_pitch_drafts
tools.description: Rewrite saved pitches or apply a template using the existing generation queue and team checks. Does not send emails.

tools.name: generate_pitch_drafts
tools.description: Generate or replace saved pitch drafts for contacts in your campaign using existing limits and team checks. Can overwrite existing draft content, including with rewrite enabled. Read drafts first and obtain approval for replacement. Does not send emails.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connected_account, get_campaign_drafts, list_inbox_threads, read_inbox_thread, mark_inbox_thread, get_inbox_counts, list_inbox_labels, generate_pitch_drafts · Private data: report_agent_bug, search_podcasts, get_podcast_details, get_account_podcast, add_contacts_to_campaign, list_excluded_contacts, exclude_contacts, list_connected_senders, generate_pitch_drafts · Public sink: get_connected_account, get_campaign_drafts, send_pitch, reply_to_inbox_thread, cancel_upcoming_send, edit_upcoming_send, reschedule_upcoming_send, rewrite_pitch_drafts, generate_pitch_drafts · Destructive: delete_template, generate_pitch_drafts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connected_account, get_campaign_drafts, list_inbox_threads, read_inbox_thread, mark_inbox_thread, get_inbox_counts, list_inbox_labels, generate_pitch_drafts · Private data: report_agent_bug, search_podcasts, get_podcast_details, get_account_podcast, add_contacts_to_campaign, list_excluded_contacts, exclude_contacts, list_connected_senders, generate_pitch_drafts · Public sink: get_connected_account, get_campaign_drafts, send_pitch, reply_to_inbox_thread, cancel_upcoming_send, edit_upcoming_send, reschedule_upcoming_send, rewrite_pitch_drafts, generate_pitch_drafts · Destructive: delete_template, generate_pitch_drafts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
